Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

SUPPORT: her back rests against the seat back.

PROP: with her own right hand she holds a small clear glass dish holding a half-melted bead of bluish-silver gallium at chest height; it is all she holds.
LEGS: legs crossed at the knee.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
